title: UAP - dreams dream dreams
content: Hi all, I'm not sure if this is the right place to post, but: Does Anybody Else experience intense dreams recently? Since this UAP thing is hot. I never claimed to be a lucid dreamer, or have any abilities besides reading and writing. But since this all stuff goes on, I have just the craziest dreams. And not few... I dream non-stop, since falling asleep to waking up, all the time intense dreams for days now. Normally, I can remember details of what I've dreamt, but now it is so much, I only recall snapshots. Every night, every minute of my sleep. And it is all really intense... like the whole life's worries and reflecting just coming at me... Wars, invasions, betrayal, injustice. Neglectful leaders, denied opportunities, and deceitful offers... every night, all night. I do struggle a little bit to wake up, to separate the dream from awake, but I am rested when I wake up. What is going on?
